One test, 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report', improved from 50% to 25% failure rate.
The observed flakiness may indicate timing issues introduced by recent changes.
This pattern could reflect instability affecting report generation for finance staff.

Further investigation into the timing of flaky tests may provide insights.
